claims.claim_vi: The source groups its cheat sheet under High Availability (hot-hot, hot-warm, single-leader cluster, leaderless cluster), High Throughput and High Scalability.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit; only the names are used.

claims.claim_vi: Hot-hot serves from several copies at once; hot-warm keeps a standby; single-leader clusters pause writes while electing a leader; leaderless clusters need quorum-style acknowledgements and reconciliation. Throughput differs from latency.
claims.verified_by: General knowledge of the author, not checked against an official document: the writing environment could only reach GitHub, and no official document for this topic is hosted there.

design_notes_vi: Khung một là bốn thẻ kiểu dự phòng; khung hai là bốn ghi chú về thông lượng và mở rộng.
source_deviations: Source is a compact cheat sheet; the lesson keeps the three goal names and four redundancy kinds and adds what happens when a node fails.
The lesson separates throughput from latency, which the source does not stress.
